text_block_list.text: At that day's Winning Live—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for your support,
everyone~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I got to stand in the center position today♪
How did I do?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Cute Curren Chaaan...!
That was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: *Hmph.*
(Murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Is that all?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Do you really... like Curren?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: SO CUUUUTE!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
I LOOOOVE HEEER!!
I LOVE CURREN CHAN SO MUUUUCH!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, thank you!
Curren loves everyone too...—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: On second thought, I'm nooot gonna tell ya♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOO!
On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Curren Fans
text_block_list.text:
Cute Curren Chan!
Cute Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe.
Did I make you fall too deeply for me♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I got the chance to stand at center stage, after all.
I wanted everyone to love me, so I gave it my absolute all♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Still... it was a wonderful sight.
Everyone was sharing that same sense of cuteness."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm gonna keep letting everyone
pamper me loooots and lots♪

And so, Curren Chan took her cuteness
to yet another level...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you,
everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah...!
Curren Chaaan...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: The one who just called out to me was...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: This one? Thank you~♪

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah~~!
On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's Curren Chan!
S-So cute...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hello~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Your voice is so cute...! Um, I watched your live performance today!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I'm so happy♪
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'm sorry, okay?
Because I wasn't able to stand at the center.

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No! I was so happy to have so many solo lines!
I just love Curren Chan's lives, so...!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
To us, you were the center!
You were so super cute!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you.
I'm so~ happy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then in the next live performance, I'll take center stage
and do even, eeeeven better!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —I'll make you say I'm cute, you'll see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Fans
text_block_list.text:
...!!
C-Cute Curren Chan!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What a great answer♪ Please keep
cheering me on, okay~♪

Hearing the voices of her fans,
Curren Chan quietly burned with determination to claim the center next time.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Thanks, everyone~♪
(Waaaaah...!)
On the way back—

text_block_list.name: Race Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Are you... Curren Chan?

text_block_list.name: Race Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I watched today's concert!
You were so cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you♪

text_block_list.name: Race Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I want to see you singing at the center!
Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Race Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If I sing at center stage...
will you fall in love with Curren?

text_block_list.name: Race Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Hyehk, ah, y-yes! Um... p-pardon me!!

text_block_list.name: Race Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wh-Who is that girl...?! She's cute... no, too cute—it's terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I messed up the adjustment a bit.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's a se-cret♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, I found something I need to work on~.
I've gotta become way, way cuter!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I want them to be so captivated next time...
that they won't even think of running away."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Now then... What should I do~♪

A hint of frustration showed on Curren Chan's face.
It seemed her ideal was still a long way off...
